Am very much worried if this is Intererst based transaction, because my cousin brother has involed allmost all our Khandaan and can say more than hundred people(Except my Family-though he tried, but was not successful) in these policies. 2.I am very much confused what RIBA(INTEREST) actuall is in Islam? answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 4878 Country: India Title: My friend is a car dealer.Most of the costomer ask him to get Car Loan sanctioned for them. Is it appropriate for him to do so? Question: My friend is a car dealer.Most of the costomer ask him to get Car Loan sanctioned for them. Is it appropriate for him to do so? Answer ID: 4878 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 514/514=M/1429) It is unlawful take car loan needlessly without any exigent compulsion. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
